newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyosung says buys stake in Korea Petrochemical.
newsitem.headline: Hyosung says buys stake in Korea Petrochemical.

text.p: South Korea's Hyosung Industries Co Ltd said on Thursday it has bought a 14.2 percent stake in Korea Petrochemical Industry Co in an effort to secure a steady supply of petrochemical feed products.
Hyosung, an unlisted unit of the Hyosung Group, bought the stake from Korea Petrochemical's partner Chisso Engineering Co Ltd of Japan for about 12 billion won, a company official said.
Korea Petrochemical, a naphtha cracking firm, has been under court receivership since 1993.
"We believe this purchase will be beneficial to both Korea Petrochemical and Hyosung," a Hyosung statement said.

The purchase makes Hyosung the third largest shareholder of Korea Petrochemical, behind the former chairman Lee Jung-ho, who holds a 42.3 percent stake, and the government's 32.7 percent. -- Seoul Newsroom (822) 727 5644
